title: Align Home metronome icon
prompt:
In lib/screens/home_screen.dart, replace the exact lines `          icon: Icons.speed,
          label: 'Metronome',` with `          icon: Icons.av_timer,
          label: 'Metronome',`. In test/screens/home_screen_test.dart, replace `      expect(find.byIcon(Icons.speed), findsOneWidget);` with `      expect(find.byIcon(Icons.av_timer), findsOneWidget);`. Update only assertions about the changed UI. Run `dart analyze lib/screens/home_screen.dart` and `flutter test test/screens/home_screen_test.dart`. Edit only the listed files; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- lib/screens/home_screen.dart && dart analyze lib/screens/home_screen.dart && flutter test test/screens/home_screen_test.dart
